# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ExamForge AI — Environment Configuration Template
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Copy this file to .env and fill in the values.
#   cp .env.example .env
#
# NEVER commit the .env file to version control.
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Supabase — Project URL and API keys from your Supabase dashboard
# Dashboard → Settings → API
SUPABASE_URL=https://.supabase.co
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=
# NOTE: The variable name must be SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (not SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY)
#       to match what Edge Functions expect via Deno.env.get()
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=

# AI Provider Keys — Required for ai-complete and ai-stream Edge Functions
# OpenAI: platform.openai.com → API Keys
OPENAI_API_KEY=
# Gemini: aistudio.google.com → API Keys
GEMINI_API_KEY=

# Firebase Cloud Messaging — Server key for push notifications
# NOTE: This is currently a PLANNED variable — no Edge Function consumes it yet.
#       FCM server-side operations must go through Edge Functions per security policy.
# Firebase Console → Project Settings → Cloud Messaging
FCM_SERVER_KEY=

# Flutterwave — Payment gateway keys
# Flutterwave Dashboard → Settings → API Keys
FLUTTERWAVE_PUBLIC_KEY=
FLUTTERWAVE_SECRET_KEY=
# Flutterwave Dashboard → Settings → Webhooks
FLUTTERWAVE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_HASH=

# Application configuration
# Environment: development | staging | production
# Determines CORS origins in Edge Functions
ENVIRONMENT=development
# Payment callback redirect URL (used by flutterwave-checkout)
APP_URL=https://app.examforge.ai
# Version identifier shown in health-check responses
DEPLOY_VERSION=1.0.0
# API base URL (for Flutter --dart-define, not .env file)
# Set via: flutter build web --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=https://api.examforge.ai/v1
